defaultMessage: Thank you for joining the server! Have fun and feel at home.

cmd.description: 👋 Post welcome cards for new members in this channel (admins only).
cmd.action: Turn welcome cards on here (default) or off.

serverOnly: ❌ This command only works in a server.
adminsOnly: ❌ Only server admins (Administrator permission) can use this command.
turnedOff: 👋 Welcome cards are turned off. Use `/welcomehere` in a channel to turn them on again.
failed: ❌ Something went wrong. Please try again.
wrongChannel: ❌ Use `/welcomehere` in a text or announcement channel.
missingPerms:
❌ Pingway can't post welcome cards in <#{channelId}>. It is missing: **{perms}**.
Give Pingway's role these permissions in this channel, then run `/welcomehere` again.
enabled: 👋 Welcome cards will be posted in <#{channelId}>. Change the design and message on the Pingway website (server settings → Welcome).
